player_prompt.intro:
Udzakabona {N} tihholo letingakuboni kugijima.
Ebusuku lobunja, uyasikhibela [accept] kukhetsa *thamani leliyekhona*, kuya ngemu [continue] ukudlula kuyo wabona leyengakho.
Ukungabi ukhetsi, uzoforukwa kuteka thamani leyekhatsi.
Unatsha (rimende = 1) **kuphela** ukuthami thamani wunakhetse nguwukhetfwe luhle kunawo onkhe.
